summary:
**Market Summary: Session of 2026-10-28**

Broad U.S. equity indexes closed higher. SPY rose 0.15% to 770.85, DIA gained 0.17%, and QQQ added 0.08%, while IWM slipped 0.05%. Energy led sectors, with XLE up 0.98% and USO up 3.27%. Technology (XLK, +0.29%) and industrials (XLI, +0.43%) also advanced. Communication services (XLC, -0.46%) and real estate (XLRE, -0.97%) lagged. Gold fell 0.58%, long Treasuries (TLT) dropped 0.46%, and the dollar (UUP) eased 0.07%.

Top eligible gainers were GMAB (+29.4%), AXGN (+28.1%) and KIDS (+23.1%). The largest decliners included BCAX (-47.6%) and OTLY (-30.6%). The most active names by volume were SPCX, NU, CCC, SOFI and NOK.

Amazon (AMZN) was the most-mentioned ticker in news, with six stories tied to its upcoming Q3 earnings. Vertiv (VRT) rose 14% after reporting orders that more than doubled.
